thread:
Maya - Finance: Quick follow-up from the AH: a few people asked about runway math and where to route odd cases. Posting concise answers here. Short version: target runway is 14 months at current plan; hiring pause applies to noncritical roles; exceptions reviewed weekly. Full deck: https://redwood.internal/all-hands/q2_finance_deck :point_right:

Darren - Eng: When you say 'noncritical roles' — does that mean we can still post IC roles for critical infra work? Need clarity for hiring plan.

Maya - Finance: Great Q. Critical infra / SRE roles are allowed with Eng lead + Product + Finance signoff. Use the "Critical Hire" form and mark risk impact. If unsure, tag @Raj for fast review.

Priya - Product: For roadmap items slated for Q3 that rely on external vendor work (design agency, contract ML labeling), should we push or request exception?

Raj - CFO: If the work is revenue-generating or tied to a committed customer milestone, submit an exception with ROI note. For exploratory/non-committed vendor work, push or scope down for now.

Sam - Infra: We have a scheduled model pretraining run in three weeks that will spike GPU spend ~3x for 48h. Can we pre-authorize a one-off burn?

Maya - Finance: Yes — submit the Temporary Budget form with expected ceiling and attach the run plan. Approvals required: infra manager + eng lead + finance ops. Include rollback/cost-control knobs.

Elena - People Ops: Clarify: signing bonus / relocation packages — are these still allowed under the pause?

Maya - Finance: Small signing bonuses (up to $5k) are allowed with manager + People Ops signoff. Larger packages require director-level approval. Use internal comp exception form.

Darren - Eng: What about canceling a vendor contract — will we cover early termination fees if we cancel due to budget constraints?

Raj - CFO: We review case-by-case. If termination saves >3x the remaining fee over the next 6 months, we may accept cancellation and cover minimal termination costs. Otherwise we negotiate credits or pause options. Procurement should lead negotiation.

procure-bot: FYI: attach current vendor contract and last invoice when filing cancellations. Missing docs slow approvals.

Priya - Product: Can finance confirm which cost centers to use for pilot customers vs internal R&D? We've been mixing codes.

Maya - Finance: Use CC-CUST-2026 for pilot/customer-facing spend, CC-RD-2026 for internal experiments. I'll update the spend matrix doc.

Darren - Eng: Can we get a simple checklist for the Temporary Budget form — fields we must populate so it doesn't bounce?

Maya - Finance: Will do. Quick checklist: expected ceiling, dates, approvers (mgr + eng lead), business justification, rollback plan, cost center, owner contact. I'll post the checklist in #docs by EOD Thursday.

Sam - Infra: Thx. Also, will finance honor pre-paid credits for cloud partners if we delay a run? Example: we bought committed credits for training.

Raj - CFO: We prefer using existing credits first; file a request with procurement to re-assign credits to another project if necessary. If credits are refundable, procurement will evaluate.

Maya - Finance: Action items: 1) I'll post the Temporary Budget checklist in #docs by EOD Thu. 2) Update spend matrix with cost centers and hiring exception flow. 3) Weekly exception reviews on Fri AM. Ping me or @Raj for urgent reviews. Closing here but DM if urgent. :white_check_mark:
